sources.title: Annual leave policy
sources.text: Employees should submit annual leave requests to their manager before making travel commitments. Managers review requests against team coverage.

sources.title: Expense reimbursement process
sources.text: Employees submit itemized receipts through the expense process. Finance reviews documentation before reimbursement is approved.

sources.title: Manager leave planning notes
sources.text: Managers should review overlapping leave requests and document coverage arrangements before confirming team schedules.
